methodology.scope: retrieve() wall time: index/metadata availability + query-vector conversion + FAISS search + result mapping. Query embedding is a precomputed vector (mock); no network or LLM time.
methodology.inputs: 50 seeded random query vectors per config, identical for both implementations; corpus vectors seeded standard normal; ~3.9 kB text per chunk
methodology.order: rounds alternate which implementation is measured first
methodology.warmup: 3 untimed queries per implementation per config (OS page cache warm for both)
methodology.memory: separate fresh interpreter per implementation; VmHWM reset via /proc/self/clear_refs after imports, then peak and retained RSS growth over 20 queries
